about_the_game:
DLC content

This DLC is designed to provide players with the option to support the game if they choose to do so. It will not add anything significant to the experience, and you will not be missing out on any content if you choose not to support.

Overview

God Fishing is an experimental idle fishing game with aspects of horror and a running narrative. You solve puzzles to find the right combinations of location and bait to find certain catches. After throwing your hook, you will have to wait for a varying amount of time. Catching a fish will reveal some dialogue which will help you understand the wider narrative.

Features part 1

  • 7 different fish to catch

  • A minimalist pixel art style

  • A wide narrative

  • A small crafting system

  • Vibes

part 2

Will be released somewhere in the future as a free update to the current game
